title: Git packfile format
summary: A Git packfile (.pack) stores objects (commits, trees, blobs, tags) in a compressed, delta-encoded form. Header: 4-byte magic 'PACK', 4-byte version (2), 4-byte number of objects. Then object entries: type+size (variable-length), compressed object (zlib), with deltas (OFS_DELTA type 6, REF_DELTA type 7) referencing a base. Trailer: 20-byte SHA-1 checksum of the pack.

ext.summary: A Git packfile (.pack) stores objects (commits, trees, blobs, tags) in a compressed, delta-encoded form. Header: 4-byte magic 'PACK', 4-byte version (2), 4-byte number of objects. Then object entries: type+size (variable-length), compressed object (zlib), with deltas (OFS_DELTA type 6, REF_DELTA type 7) referencing a base. Trailer: 20-byte SHA-1 checksum of the pack.

structure.meaning: Count of objects in this pack (big-endian).

First byte: 3-bit type (1 commit, 2 tree, 3 blob, 4 tag, 6 OFS_DELTA, 7 REF_DELTA) + 4-bit size (MSB continuation). Followed by more bytes if size needs more bits (7 bits per continuation byte, MSB = continue).
zlib-deflated object content (or delta instructions for OFS/REF_DELTA).
For type 6: negative offset from this entry to the base object (variable-length, MSB continuation with offset encoding).
For type 7: SHA-1 of the base object (must be in this or another pack).
SHA-1 of all preceding bytes in the pack.

ext.example_decoded: Pack header 'PACK' version 2, 1 object, then a blob entry
notes: Packfiles are generated by 'git repack' and 'git gc'; loose objects are individual zlib-compressed files in .git/objects/.
Delta chains: OFS_DELTA references by offset (preferred, faster), REF_DELTA by SHA-1 (for cross-pack).
Thin packs (used in push/fetch) can reference objects not in the pack (base is in the receiver's repo).
Index file (.idx) maps object SHA-1 -> offset in the pack for O(1) lookup.
Pack v3 adds .keep and bitmap indexes for faster reachability.
